_about: Every knob of the tour-suggestions POC. Read again on every request – edit, save, press 'Vorschläge' again. 'activities.<name>' overrides any section below for that activity. Tune against bench.py, not by eye.

simple._about: The page's few controls -> the numbers the engine works with. A level sets the taste slider(s); natur = forest + natural ground.

generator._about: Fan of loops around the start: directions x shapes; each loop is routed leg by leg, resized until its time fits. Then loops through the destinations in reach (attractions).

netsearch._about: Variant B (netsearch.py): loops searched inside the way network. cost per metre = 1 + k_taste x (1 - pleasure) + pen_street / pen_main, x (1 + cf_weight x (profile cost factor - 1)). Anchors: sectors x bands (band = share of the wished length walked to the anchor). used_penalty = factor on ways already walked. keep_length_off = loops further from the wished time are dropped before scoring.

lake._about: 'Am Wasser entlang' (Wasser >= from_water): loops made for the named lakes in reach (the max_lakes with the most way at the water). The way there is a fairly direct one (the usual dislikes to the power direct_power – through town if need be), at most stem_max of the wished length; then round the lake if the length allows it, else along the shore each way; home another way.

follow._about: Loops built along a known route: a short stem (at most stem_max of the wished length) onto the route, along it to the point where stem + route + way home fill the wished length (only points the route reaches fairly directly: direct_max x the straight line), back another way (ways already used cost used_penalty; other known routes are cheap through the discount). Only from 'Bekannte Wege' >= from_signed; the best max_routes routes by rank x length in reach, each in both directions.

netsearch._reserve: Through the heart: named protected areas with >= reserve_min_way_m of ways in reach (the reserve_targets nearest) get loops built through them (in – through, staying inside – home another way) and their far gate as a turning point. 0 = off. Off for bikes (0): on their large networks it cost 1–2 s per request and changed no first suggestion on the bench; bike loops reach the areas through the chain of green patches.

attractions._about: Destinations: named lakes, known routes and named trails, viewpoints (attractions.py). source 'cells' = the app's own map areas (cells.py get …), 'overpass' = the old online stand-in. rank = how much a route's network counts; named trails from the map's trail labels count as lwn. lake_skip = names that are no destination. lake_pad_cells = how far from the water a way still counts as 'at the lake' (cells of ~30 m on top of the usual two: 2 = about 120 m).

routing._about: Profile parameters derived from the wish. A taste slider at or above 'from' switches the profile option on. mainroad_penalty (POC addition to the hiking and bike profiles – service/make_profiles.py) = base + per_quiet x Ruhe.

effort._about: ascent per km: 'max' = full points up to here, zero at 3 x max; 'min' = full points from here
effort._cap: up_m_per_h = a clear cap (owner 2026-11-13, Meran: 'wie wollen wir mit Steigung umgehen?'): metres up per hour of the tour; a loop above it is not offered for this Anstrengung (if none is below it, the flattest are shown with a note). The card shows '↑ 420 m · mittel'. Proposed values, not yet tried by the owner.

classes._about: How way tags become values. forest/noise/river/town = BRouter's estimated_*_class (none, 1..6). Way kinds: G = along a main road (the road itself, or a pavement / cycle path beside it), S = quiet street, W = way near forest, P = other way.

main._about: How much a piece counts as 'along a main road' (0..1, suggest.main_weight). base = the road class; calm_maxspeed x calm_factor = a 30 km/h road is no main road; track_factor / lane_factor = a cycle track / lane on the road; bridge_factor = bridges (often the only crossing); sidewalk / beside = a pavement / a separate cycle path beside a loud road. class_from = from here the piece is shown and counted as 'an Hauptstraße'; run_from = from here it adds (weighted metres) to the longest stretch. Hike = the old rule: everything 1.
main._beside: Owner 2026-11-13: along a road is always bad, signed route or not. A separate way (beside_ways) beside a busy road counts by the routing data's noise class (beside_noise: 4 = a road near, 6 = right beside a loud road); x beside_forest_factor where the way is in forest all the same.
main._geo: beside_geo: a separate way (beside_ways) that runs beside a road with car traffic – found by geometry (netsearch.RoadGrid, cells of ~12 m; at least two of its points at 1/4, 1/2, 3/4 lie at the road) – counts road weight x beside_geo, also along a country road where the routing data has no noise class (owner 2026-11-13, Nordkirchen: 'auf einer Landstraße wandern'). unclassified_traffic: a small road between places counts by its traffic class (none = a farm lane = 0).

score._about: Each part is 0..1; score = weighted mean x 100. Taste parts (forest, quiet, water, signed, natural) are multiplied by the wish slider (0..1). mainroad = the longest continuous stretch along a main road: full points up to main_road_max_m, zero at main_road_zero_factor x that.
score._taste_rules: Owner's taste rules 2026-11-13 (docs/design/tour-suggestions.md): selfcross = the loop meets its own way (0, 1, 2+ times -> selfcross_value; 2+ is not offered, select.max_self_cross). roadside = weighted share on / beside a busy road, zero at roadside_zero_at. town = share through houses, zero at town_zero_at. deep = large connected nature around the way (nature.py), full at deep_full_at; counts x the Natur level. natur_scaled: these parts weigh x (1 + value x Natur) – roads and houses hurt more when nature was asked for; main_road_natur shrinks the free roadside stretch the same way. free_stem_m = a way out and back at the start that costs nothing. length_flat_km = the length is a rough guide: full points within +- this.
score._night: 2026-11-14: green = share of the loop in green (in / at nature, at a bank, on a rail trail; not a street, not beside a road), full at green_full_at – 'die Länge, die ich durch was Grünes fahre, ist wichtig'. railtrail = share on a rail trail, full at railtrail_full_at, only counted in a run where a candidate has >= railtrail_min_km. water: also the share directly at open water (bank_full_share); the routing data's river class counts only river_class_factor. flaws = POINTS OFF on top of the mean, so one bad thing puts a loop clearly behind a clean one: road = the longest stretch on / beside a busy road beyond the free stretch (per 100 m, x (1 + road_natur x Natur), capped); built = share through houses beyond built_free (per 10 %, x (built_base + Natur)); doubled = share walked twice beyond the free stem and doubled_free; cross = per meeting with the own way; roadside = weighted share on / beside roads beyond roadside_free.
score._reserve: A named protected area is the loop's MAIN area when the loop has the most km in it and at least reserve_main_km and reserve_main_share of its length there (owner 2026-11-14, Hirschpark Nordkirchen: used, not touched). Then the area leads the card's name and reason line, and the free way out and back to the loop may be up to reserve_stem_m (at most reserve_stem_share of the loop).

surface._about: The form's line 'Wegbeschaffenheit', per activity: label + pleasure value per surface class (A = asphalt / paved, F = firm: compacted, gravel, good track, N = natural ground; classes.surface_*). 'avoid' = classes the search keeps off (netsearch.surface_avoid_factor). Score part 'surface' = length-weighted value.

nature._about: Deep nature (nature.py): share of forest / heath / wetland / protected area within radii_m around a point (mean of the radii); below 'from' it counts nothing, from 'full' fully. search_radius_m = the one radius the network search uses per way.
nature._built: Through houses (score part 'town', netsearch pen_town): a way counts when the share of the map's built-up land (landuse residential / commercial / industrial / retail / railway / schools …) within built_radius_m around it is at least built_from – inside housing, not merely near a town. Replaces the routing data's town class (owner 2026-11-13: the loop he liked had 60 % by the old measure, the one 'zu viel durch Orte' 47 %; now 35 % and 46 %).
nature._green: green_radius_m / green_from: a piece counts as 'in green' when the nature share within green_radius_m is at least green_from; bank_radius_m / bank_from: 'directly at open water' when the water share within bank_radius_m is at least bank_from.

greenchain._about: Variant C (greenchain.py): the green-patch chain. green = no street, main-road weight < green_max_main, not built-up, and nature share within green_radius_m >= green_from, or forest class >= green_forest_class, or at a bank (water share within bank_radius_m >= bank_from). Green ways that hang together = a patch (a not-green piece up to join_gap_m between two green ones joins them); patches under min_patch_m green metres are dropped, the max_patches most worthwhile kept. Connectors: least unpleasant way to each neighbouring patch, at most max_connector_share of the wished length, up to 'alternatives' gates >= gate_sep_m apart. Chain worth = green metres inside patches x quality - connector_weight x (1 + connector_natur x Natur) x unpleasant metres of connectors; inside a patch the way may be stretched up to stretch_share of its green metres (at most stretch_max_share of the wish). realise = how many chains become real loops.
greenchain._q_power: chain worth uses patch quality ^ q_power (tried 2.0 with max_connector_share 0.45: Hilden hike unchanged, Düsseldorf lost its only loop) – 1.0.
greenchain._touch: touch_cost_share x wished length = extra cost for a way that touches a node the loop already passed (tried at 0.15: no gain for bikes, and the loops inside the Ohligser Heide got worse) – off.

ai._about: Stage 2, only with the switch 'mit KI-Regionswissen' (wish.ai): the AI's picks per map area (region_ai.py, one call per area, files in ~/onpath-suggest-poc/region-ai/) as the score part 'ai' (score.weights.ai) and as extra destinations in variant B. bonus: every ~30 m of the loop counts once with the rang value of the best pick it lies on / in; the rang-weighted share of the loop is full at full_share. route_pick_factor: a pick that is a signed route counts only this much (the 'signed' part already pays for it). A sight passed adds point_value x rang value, up to point_cap. targets = how many picks (areas, sights, river banks) become anchors; target_min_frac = not closer than this share of the wished length.

select._about: One selection for every kind of loop. Best first; each further one: shares at most max_shared of its length with a shown one; value = points - shared_cost x shared share - same_dir_cost when it heads the same way (within same_dir_deg) as a shown one; not shown when more than floor_points behind the best ('lieber zwei gute als fünf mit drei schlechten'); time at most max_length_off from the wish (plus half the free band); meets its own way at most max_self_cross times.
select._water: With 'am Wasser entlang' (Wasser >= lake_slot_from_water): loops really at the water (lake shore / bank >= water_min_km and >= water_min_share of the loop) get up to water_slots places unless more than water_max_behind points behind the best, and stand first.
select._reserve: name_area_km: a card is named after a protected area only with at least this many km in it. Coverage: each named protected area that is the main area of a loop with >= reserve_cover_km in it gets one shown suggestion (up to reserve_cover_slots added), unless that loop is more than reserve_cover_behind points behind the first.

activities._about: Per activity: label, BRouter profile, pace words (km/h on the flat), and overrides of the sections above.

places._about: Quick picks for the start field; any other name goes to Nominatim (online), 'lat, lon' also works.
